messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High error rate detected for rollout group 'rl-alpha' (model rl-v2-quant). 5xx spike 12:07 UTC. Affected customers: repos/finance-api, chat-sessions. Link: https://logs.company/incident/2498765432 :rotating_light:
Mike O'Connor: I'm on call, looking now. Any immediate customer-visible impact?
Emma Li: seeing 5xx increase + latency tail. Some requests failing with decode errors. Not all regions.
Raj Patel: grabbing canary diff + recent deploys. Stand by.
Maria Gomez: I'm with support — customers pinging for failures in finance-api, looks like retries are amplifying errors.
Mike O'Connor: @Emma can you share a sample error?
Emma Li: sample from logshare: https://logshare.company/s/abc123
Emma Li: ``ERROR: decode_kernel: invalid cache size``, repeated ~10k times last 15m
Raj Patel: here's the canary diff metrics I pulled:```
--- canary/rl-v2-quant @20260214T11:45
+++ prod/rl-v2-quant @20260214T12:00
+ token-error-rate: 0.48% -> 3.9%
+ 99p latency: 210ms -> 875ms
+ ooms: 0 -> 0 (no OOMs)
+ backend-errors (5xx): 8/hr -> 420/hr
```
Raj Patel: also diffed kernels: quant-kernel-v3 -> quant-kernel-v4 (the newer kernel switched some packing options)
Mike O'Connor: hypothesis: quant kernel changes broke KV cache layout leading to decode failures under certain seq lengths.
Emma Li: I can repro locally with sequence length > 1024 on rl-v2-quant v4, get same decode error.
Kevin Zhou: if that's the case, we should pin model runtime to previous kernel and roll back the canary. Pining option: `rctl model-pin --model=rl-v2-quant --kernel=quant-kernel-v3`
Maria Gomez: customers already on retries — what's our mitigation plan to reduce impact now?
Mike O'Connor: short-term: 1) disable canary traffic routing to v4 (stop rollout), 2) pin model to quant-kernel-v3 for all production nodes, 3) inform customers with ETA.
Emma Li: doing capture of additional logs and timeline. Will paste order of events shortly.
Support Bot: Notified affected customers: "We've identified an issue with a recent performance update causing intermittent failures; mitigation in progress."
Emma Li: timeline (collected): ``12:00 deploy of quant-kernel-v4 rolled to canary (5% traffic)`` ``12:07 first 5xx spike flagged by anomaly detector`` ``12:10 engineering pager triggered`` ``12:18 canary traffic at 15% due to auto-burst policy`` ``12:25 errors escalated, support alerts raised`` ``12:31 attempted preliminary rollback to canary but routing error prevented full rollback```
Raj Patel: log snippet of the decode stack:```
[2026-02-14T12:09:22Z] ERROR decode_kernel: mismatch at kv_index=1048576 expected 0x7f got 0x00
stack: decode.cpp:412 -> kv_cache.cpp:88 -> runtime_dispatch.cpp:210
```
Kevin Zhou: if we can't rollback routing quickly due to the burst autoscaling policy, pinning kernel might be faster. I'll run the pin command in dry-run then apply.
Mike O'Connor: go for it. Keep me posted.
Kevin Zhou: running: `rctl model-pin --model=rl-v2-quant --kernel=quant-kernel-v3 --apply`
Ops Bot: ACTION: model-pin job started (job id: mp-87321). ETA ~3m. Link: https://ops.company/jobs/mp-87321
Raj Patel: sharing diffs and checksums for v3 vs v4: https://artifacts.company/models/rl-v2-quant/diffs/20260214
Emma Li: confirmed: after pin apply at 12:36 UTC error rate started trending down. Post-pin 5xxs dropped from 320/hr -> 18/hr within 5m.
Mike O'Connor: rollback decision: we will roll forward the canary to v3 across prod until kernel issue is resolved. We'll keep a block window for the next deploys.
Maria Gomez: customers updated with rollback notice and ETA. One large customer requested a followup call, scheduled 13:00 UTC.
Support Bot: Updated incident status: mitigation in progress -> partial mitigation achieved.
Emma Li: collecting artifacts for RCA: logs, canary diffs, kernel change PR (https://git.company/p/rl-runtime/changes/455), pin job id, and timeline.
Raj Patel: hypothesis tracking: 1) kernel packing change corrupts KV cache for seq>1024 (primary) 2) memory alignment difference leads to intermittent decode errors (secondary) 3) config mismatch in autoscale policy amplified exposure (tertiary).
Kevin Zhou: mitigation checklist performed: pin applied, canary traffic halted, autoscale cap lowered to prevent further bursts.
Mike O'Connor: handoff to day team: Emma & Raj to produce RCA draft, Kevin to run extended regression tests for quant-kernel-v4, Maria to coordinate customer comms. I'll mark this as on-call handoff at 13:05 UTC.
Emma Li: noted. We'll create postmortem doc and link it here once drafted. Suggested labels: postmortem, root-cause:kernel, mitigation:pin, followup:regression-tests
Maria Gomez: adding required customer impact notes: affected endpoints, estimated affected requests ~2.6k in window, severity: P1.
Support Bot: Logged customer impact details to incident tracker (INC-2026-114).
Incident Bot: Incident metrics summary added to thread: duration 00:59, peak 5xx 3.9% of requests, mitigation: model-pin -> success, follow-ups assigned.
Kevin Zhou: note for RCA: include test matrix for seq lengths, tokenization edge cases, and comparison of quant packing layout between v3/v4.
Raj Patel: uploading logs bundle: https://logs.company/download/2498765432/bundle.tar.gz
Emma Li: final note before handoff: immediate customer impact mitigated; root cause likely kernel packing change. Will follow up with RCA doc and rollout guard recommendations.
Mike O'Connor: thanks team. I'll update on-call notes and close pager when RCA doc lands. :thumbsup:
